description.it: JWT (decodifica, verifica della firma, creazione), anche dai token delle utenze dell'HTTP client; codifica e decodifica Base64, URL, HTML, hex, Unicode, JSON; hash MD5, SHA, HMAC; UUID, stringhe casuali, timestamp
description.en: JWT (decode, signature check, create), also from the tokens of the HTTP client's user types; Base64, URL, HTML, hex, Unicode, JSON encode and decode; MD5, SHA, HMAC hashes; UUIDs, random strings, timestamps
